title: No session guard: every buyer page is served to anonymous visitors
expected: Unauthenticated requests to amazon.html, checkout.html, orders.html, user_details.html, payments.html and tracking.html are redirected to login.html.
actual: All six pages render their full content without any login; no session token is created at login time either.
repro: Open http://127.0.0.1:5501/checkout.html directly in a fresh browser profile.
rootCause: login.html never persists an authenticated session and no page performs an access check.

title: Card number is written into the URL by a GET form submission
expected: Payment data is never exposed in the address bar, browser history or Referer header.
actual: payments.html submits through GET with named inputs, producing ?card-number=4111111111111112&expiration-date=...&cvv=...
repro: Submit a valid card on payments.html and inspect the address bar after the success alert.
rootCause: The Proceed control is a bare submit button inside a form with no method/action and no preventDefault.

title: Hard-coded credentials shipped in client-side source
expected: Credential verification happens server side; no secret appears in page source.
actual: login.html contains both valid username/password pairs in an inline script.
repro: View source of login.html and search for the password strings.
rootCause: Authentication implemented entirely in the browser for the assignment demo.

title: Credential policy violated: numeric-only password accepted
expected: Per REQ-09.3 the password must be at least 8 characters with mixed character classes.
actual: The account 'Yogesh' authenticates with the 10-digit phone number 8329097855.
repro: Log in with Yogesh / 8329097855.
rootCause: No password policy is enforced anywhere in the application.

title: Expiry date validation accepts impossible and past dates
expected: Months 01-12 only, and any date earlier than the current month must be refused.
actual: The expression /^\d{2}\/\d{2}$/ accepts 13/25, 99/99 and 01/20.
repro: Enter expiry 13/25 (or 99/99, or 01/20) with a valid card and CVV, then press Proceed.
rootCause: isValidExpirationDate in payments.html only checks the shape of the string.

title: Login failure message blames the wrong field
expected: An unknown username must be reported as a username problem.
actual: An unknown username with the password '5555' is reported as 'Invalid Password'.
repro: Submit username 'nobody' with password '5555'.
rootCause: login.html tests the password branch before the username branch.

title: Zipcode accepts any character and any length
expected: Zipcode is constrained to 5-10 numeric characters.
actual: 'ABCDE', '90' and a 12-digit string are all accepted as a valid address.
repro: Fill the address form with zipcode 'ABCDE' and press Next.
rootCause: user_details.html only checks that the field is non-empty.

title: Card number accepts any 16 digits (no checksum)
expected: A card that fails the Luhn checksum is refused.
actual: 0000000000000000 is accepted as a successful payment.
repro: Pay with card 0000000000000000, expiry 12/28, CVV 123.
rootCause: isValidCardNumber in payments.html only tests /^\d{16}$/.

title: Hard-coded host and port in an onclick handler
expected: All navigation is origin relative so the app can be served from any host or port.
actual: orders.html line 176 navigates to http://127.0.0.1:5501/user_details.html.
repro: Serve the app on any port other than 5501 and press 'Buy it again' on the third order.
rootCause: Absolute URL literal inside the inline onclick attribute.

title: Header search is disabled and unimplemented
expected: The search button is enabled and filters the catalogue by the entered query.
actual: The button carries the disabled attribute and no filtering code exists.
repro: Open amazon.html, type 'basketball' and try to search.
rootCause: amazon.html renders <button disabled class="search-button"> and scripts/amazon.js has no search handler.

title: Successful form submissions dead-end instead of advancing the flow
expected: Address step routes to payments.html; payment routes to an order confirmation.
actual: Both steps only alert and then perform a native GET reload of the same page.
repro: Complete user_details.html or payments.html and watch the address bar.
rootCause: The Proceed controls are submit buttons with no preventDefault and no navigation logic.

title: Quantity selector is ignored when adding to cart
expected: Choosing quantity 5 adds five units to the cart.
actual: Exactly one unit is added regardless of the selected quantity.
repro: On amazon.html select quantity 5 on any product and press Add to Cart.
rootCause: scripts/amazon.js reads only data-product-id and never the adjacent <select>.

title: Product detail pages load a script that does not exist (HTTP 404)
expected: products/backpack.html and products/basketball.html wire their Add to Cart / Buy Now buttons.
actual: Both pages request ../scripts/product-details.js which the server answers with 404, so the buttons are inert.
repro: Open products/backpack.html, press Add to Cart, and check the cart counter.
rootCause: Missing asset: scripts/product-details.js was never committed.

title: Checkout header cart counter is never synchronised
expected: The header counter shows the live cart quantity on checkout.html and updates after deletions.
actual: The counter keeps the hard-coded 0 for the whole session on that page.
repro: Open checkout.html with a non-empty cart, then delete a line.
rootCause: scripts/checkout.js never touches .js-cart-quantity.

title: Delivery option radios have no effect
expected: Selecting a delivery option updates the displayed delivery date and the shipping charge.
actual: The radios have no change handler; the line keeps 'Tuesday, June 21'.
repro: On checkout.html select the third delivery option.
rootCause: scripts/checkout.js renders the radios but binds no listener.

title: Order summary panel is static markup
expected: Item count and amounts are computed from the live cart.
actual: The panel always shows Items (3) / $42.75 / $52.51 regardless of cart content.
repro: Delete a cart line or add a product, then re-open checkout.html.
rootCause: checkout.html hard-codes the summary rows; only the line list is dynamic.

title: Buy-it-again buttons are inert or misrouted
expected: Pressing Buy it again returns that product to the cart.
actual: #product-1 and #product-2 have no handler; #product-3 navigates to the address form.
repro: On orders.html press any Buy it again button and inspect the cart.
rootCause: orders.html defines the buttons without behaviour (except one onclick literal).

title: Tracking page hard-codes the cart counter
expected: The header counter reflects the real cart size on every page.
actual:
tracking.html renders
3
with no js- hook, so it always shows 3.
repro: Seed a one-item cart and open tracking.html.
rootCause: tracking.html omits the js-cart-quantity class used by the header script.

title: Catalogue header cart counter is not synchronised on page load
expected: Opening amazon.html with items already in the cart shows the live unit count in the header counter.
actual: The header keeps the hard-coded 0 for a returning buyer until an Add to Cart click runs; a seeded 3-unit cart still displays 0 after a reload.
repro: Seed the cart with 3 units in localStorage, open amazon.html, and read the header counter before clicking anything.
rootCause: scripts/amazon.js calls updateCartQuantity() only inside the add-to-cart click handler (line 80) and never on initial render, while amazon.html hard-codes .js-cart-quantity to 0.

title: Shipping charge contradicts the selected delivery option
expected: The summary charges the price of the pre-selected delivery option (FREE by default).
actual: The summary always charges $4.99 while the default radio is FREE Shipping.
repro: Open checkout.html and compare the first delivery option with the shipping row.
rootCause: Static summary markup plus unbound delivery radios.

title: Login page logo anchor is not keyboard reachable
expected: Interactive anchors expose an href so keyboard users can reach them.
actual: login.html renders <a id="header-link"> without href.
repro: Tab through login.html and try to activate the logo.
rootCause: Anchor used as a click target without a destination.

title: Empty cart renders a blank review page
expected: An empty cart shows an explanatory message and a link back to the catalogue.
actual: The order summary area renders nothing at all.
repro: Delete every cart line and reload checkout.html.
rootCause: scripts/checkout.js concatenates zero line templates and writes an empty string.
